overview_description.description: Dashworks is a knowledge assistant that helps employees find the information they need while also increasing productivity. Dashworks is where all documents, messages, tickets, and other knowledge scattered across a company's apps and people come together seamlessly. Dashworks assists every organization in growing more efficiently and effectively — and in motivating every person to get things done.
